nightly-bot: nightly-eval: run 2026-03-19T03:00Z — model=redwood-open-3b-q4. Failures: math-small (blank lines), longcontext-struct (truncated JSON), instruction-stability (weird token repeats). Severity: medium. Owners: @sana (primary), @oliver (backup). Links: https://ci/internal/runs/1764509999
sana: on it. assigning myself. can someone paste a repro for math-small?
maria: i pulled the run. quick note: tokenizer returns merged tokens for 'e.g. 2/3' -> output dropped after '/' sometimes. suspect tokenizer merges create empty decodes after quant kernels.
oliver: interesting. which quant kernel? int4 or q4? logs show quant_backend=qkernel_v2
sana: qkernel_v2 int4_q4 path. repro:
```
./eval/run.sh --model redwood-open-3b-q4 --suite math-small --seed 42
# sample failing prompt:
"What is 2/3 as decimal to 3 places?"
```
lee: I see blank response at token offset 12, then EOS. attaching snippet: `... 2 / 3` got encoded to ['2','/3'] -> kernel produced zero-likelihood token.
ankur: :eyes: Could be merge vs bpe boundary. Also check KV cache alignment for coalesced tokens.
maria: i ran with older kernel qkernel_v1 and int8 fallback — passes. sounds like regression in v2 kernel.
sana: plan: 1) isolate kernel difference 2) run single-step with logger 3) block rollout and notify infra if needed. owners: @sana runs kernel diff, @oliver checks kvcache. severity uplift to P1 if we see production impact.
oliver: i'll add a short diff script. pinging @eng-runtime to hold any canary deploys.
